request.instructions:
You audit the close of a design session for 3D printing in OpenSCAD. The harness verified the final version of the design and gives you, in JSON, what it measured (VERIFIED) and the spec adjustments it detected: changes of the spec towards what the mesh already measured, without the part changing (ADJUSTMENTS). Read the designer's CLOSE and answer only with a JSON object, with no text before or after it:
{"unsupported": [{"claim": "...", "reason": "..."}], "untold_adjustments": [{"adjustment": "...", "reason": "..."}]}
- unsupported: every claim the close presents as verified (measured, checked, that it meets, that it fits, that it does not collide, that it goes in, that it prints without supports) that VERIFIED does not back: it is not there, it says something else or the numbers do not match. Leave out: what the close states as not verified, an opinion, an intention, or a description of the design that does not claim to have been checked.
- untold_adjustments: every part of ADJUSTMENTS whose adjustments the close does not mention with their reason (one mention per part saying what was adjusted and why is enough).
Empty lists if there is nothing to object to. Be precise: quote the claim as it is written.

- Joint is captive printed-in-place: pin d4.0 mm in bore d4.6 mm = 0.3 mm radial clearance, caps d6.0 mm in d6.6 mm pockets = 0.3 mm radial + 0.3 mm vertical clearance, giving measured 0.3 mm gaps link1-link2 and link2-link3 with clearance 0.3 mm [[print_in_place]]; knuckle 7.6 mm OD = 1.5 mm wall [[link/knuckle]]; body [[link/body]], neck [[link/neck]], slot void [[link/slot]], cap cavity void [[link/cap_cavity]], wall 3.7 mm [[link/wall]], floor 5.0 mm [[link/floor]] all measured.

- Assembly is one group, 3 copies of link as declared [[assembly]], every part held captive - none comes off straight [[assembly]], assembly order in one print-in-place step [[assembly_order]].
- Support-free: all overhangs declared, 28.4% of link surface [[link]] and 32.6% of assembly [[assembly]]; worst bridge 8.4 mm at the end knuckle under 10 mm [[G5]], fits Bambu Lab A1 [[G5]].

- The full ten-link 180 mm bracelet and the end-link snap closure from the request are not modeled - only the requested 3-link demo with `copies`=3 is verified; the snap must be added for a wearable.
- Spec adjustments made to match the captive-joint redesign: link bounds max-x 19.7->21.9 mm and assembly 55.7->57.9 mm for the closed 7.6 mm knuckle lips extending to x=21.8, and link `through_holes` 0->2 because the bore plus slot now read as through paths. response.instructions:
You audit the close of a design session for 3D printing in OpenSCAD. The harness verified the final version of the design and gives you, in JSON, what it measured (VERIFIED) and the spec adjustments it detected: changes of the spec towards what the mesh already measured, without the part changing (ADJUSTMENTS). Read the designer's CLOSE and answer only with a JSON object, with no text before or after it:
{"unsupported": [{"claim": "...", "reason": "..."}], "untold_adjustments": [{"adjustment": "...", "reason": "..."}]}
- unsupported: every claim the close presents as verified (measured, checked, that it meets, that it fits, that it does not collide, that it goes in, that it prints without supports) that VERIFIED does not back: it is not there, it says something else or the numbers do not match. Leave out: what the close states as not verified, an opinion, an intention, or a description of the design that does not claim to have been checked.
- untold_adjustments: every part of ADJUSTMENTS whose adjustments the close does not mention with their reason (one mention per part saying what was adjusted and why is enough).
Empty lists if there is nothing to object to. Be precise: quote the claim as it is written.
